Lena (CSM): Heads up: PolarBridge flagged as renewal-risk in today's scan. Active API keys down ~48% in 9 days and primary champion (E. Kim) moved to infra. Need quick triage.
Diego (AM): Oof. Any ticket noise or recent infra changes?
Lena (CSM): Two support tickets about increased token spend two weeks ago; one root-cause was a client-side retry bug.
Harper (SE): Can we get route-level drop? If it's embeddings vs generation we can tailor ask.
Lena (CSM): embeddings-heavy pipelines down 60%, generation steady.
watchdog-bot: Alert: sudden drop in embeddings tokens for customer_id=polarbridge detected (auto).
Marta (Solutions Eng): Proposal: offer 10-day free sandbox + 1:1 onboarding for their new ML lead. Also prep a short health-runbook.
Diego (AM): Procurement mentioned a competing vendor demo last week in notes. Could be POC.
Harper (SE): Quick check: no model fallback logged; latency steady. Suspect client lib change or key rotation.
Lena (CSM): Draft message I'll send: "We noticed decreased embeddings traffic; can you confirm any SDK/key changes? We'd like to offer a short sandbox and targeted enablement"
Diego (AM): I'll flag CRM as "at-risk: advocate-moved" and schedule a 30m QBR with ops + procurement.
Marta (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble a 30-min workshop (embeds best practices + cost vs latency knobs).
Harper (SE): Runbook snippet: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds/status` then capture 5 p50 samples and last 5 request IDs.
Lena (CSM): Actions: 1) Harper verify telemetry (ETA 45m) 2) Marta workshop deck (ETA 18h) 3) Diego schedule QBR & update CRM 4) Lena outreach with sandbox invite.
Lena (CSM): I'll ping after customer reply. :pray:
